name: 到期管家
description: Track recurring due dates and Apple Reminders with compact widgets, safe completion history, local backups, optional notifications, and checked updates.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.7.3 expands circular masks for enlarged brand artwork from 24 to 28 pt, giving logos such as ChatGPT more edge room without further image zoom. The app, picker and small widget share the adjustment. Original SafePal and Telegram sizes, 40 pt tap targets, brand choices and startup behavior are unchanged.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.7.3 将放大品牌图案的圆形裁剪直径从 24 pt 放宽到 28 pt，让 ChatGPT 等图案外缘保留更多余量，图片本身不再放大。主界面、选择页和小号组件同步调整。SafePal、Telegram 原尺寸、40 pt 点击区、品牌选择与启动方式不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.7.3 将放大品牌图案的圆形裁剪直径从 24 pt 放宽到 28 pt，让 ChatGPT 等图案外缘保留更多余量，图片本身不再放大。主界面、选择页和小号组件同步调整。SafePal、Telegram 原尺寸、40 pt 点击区、品牌选择与启动方式不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.7.3 將放大品牌圖案的圓形裁剪直徑從 24 pt 放寬到 28 pt，讓 ChatGPT 等圖案外緣保留更多餘量，圖片本身不再放大。主介面、選擇頁和小號元件同步調整。SafePal、Telegram 原尺寸、40 pt 點擊區、品牌選擇與啟動方式不變。
